fortress.definition: Every app of one household joined with the same phrase. Its members see the state and the log of every app in it.

th.singular: ป้อมปราการ
th.plural: ป้อมปราการ

instance.definition: One running copy of an app on one device.

member.definition: An instance inside a fortress or group. Removing it puts that one instance out.

permission.definition: An action one app may start in another, such as asking for a backup or running a job. On by default and switched off one by one. Seeing needs none. The English word also names file and system permissions, so translations are held to the forbidden variants alone.

relay.definition: The server members talk through when they cannot reach each other directly.

backup.definition: A saved copy that can be restored.

th.singular: ข้อมูลสำรอง
th.plural: ข้อมูลสำรอง

pairing.definition: Linking instances through the phrase so they trust each other.

phrase.definition: The twelve words an instance joins a fortress or group with, and the only way in. There is one phrase, never a phrase per fortress, so it carries no other name.

forbidden: วลีป้อมปราการ

job.definition: Work set up once that an app then runs by itself, on a schedule or on demand.

signIn.definition: Proving to an app who you are, with a password, a passkey, a sign-in service or the fortress. Each sign-in starts a session.

th.singular: การลงชื่อเข้าใช้
th.plural: การลงชื่อเข้าใช้
stems: ลงชื่อเข้าใช้
เข้าสู่ระบบ

signInService.definition: An OpenID Connect server that people sign in at in place of the app's own form. The interface never calls it a provider, since that word already names the storage and notification services an app picks from.

forbidden: *アイデンティティプロバイダ*

th.singular: บริการลงชื่อเข้าใช้
th.plural: บริการลงชื่อเข้าใช้

account.definition: One person in an app, with their name, their ways in and their role. An account is a person, a member is an instance.

role.definition: What a person may do in an app, set on their account. What one app may start in another is a permission.

serviceGroup.definition: A group the sign-in service reports for a person. Group alone will do only where no group of instances stands nearby.

ca.singular: grup al servei d'inici de sessió
ca.plural: grups al servei d'inici de sessió

es.singular: grupo del servicio de inicio de sesión
es.plural: grupos del servicio de inicio de sesión

gl.singular: grupo do servizo de inicio de sesión
gl.plural: grupos do servizo de inicio de sesión

ja.singular: ログインサービスのグループ
ja.plural: ログインサービスのグループ

pt.singular: grupo no serviço de início de sessão
pt.plural: grupos no serviço de início de sessão

th.singular: กลุ่มในบริการลงชื่อเข้าใช้
th.plural: กลุ่มในบริการลงชื่อเข้าใช้

vi.singular: nhóm ở dịch vụ đăng nhập
vi.plural: nhóm ở dịch vụ đăng nhập

trustedProxy.definition: A reverse proxy in front of the app whose word the app takes on where a request comes from.

th.singular: พร็อกซีที่เชื่อถือได้
th.plural: พร็อกซีที่เชื่อถือได้

fortressSignIn.definition: Signing in to an app through the fortress it is in, instead of at its own form or at a sign-in service.

ca.singular: inici de sessió amb la fortalesa
ca.plural: inicis de sessió amb la fortalesa

es.singular: inicio de sesión con la fortaleza
es.plural: inicios de sesión con la fortaleza

pt.singular: início de sessão com a fortaleza
pt.plural: inícios de sessão com a fortaleza

th.singular: การลงชื่อเข้าใช้ด้วยป้อมปราการ
th.plural: การลงชื่อเข้าใช้ด้วยป้อมปราการ

passkey.definition: A key on a device or in a password manager that signs a person in without the password. It stands beside the password, never in its place.

twoFactor.definition: A code from an authenticator app that the sign-in asks for after the password. Two-factor will do as a short form, 2FA will not.

th.singular: การยืนยันตัวตนแบบสองปัจจัย
th.plural: การยืนยันตัวตนแบบสองปัจจัย
stems: สองขั้นตอน

session.definition: One sign-in in one browser, until it runs out or is ended. A session belongs to a person, a pairing links instances.

apiToken.definition: A secret that a script sends in place of a sign-in. A person creates it and can revoke it.
